title: Common-stage lift of supplied finite normalized tensor models
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme X with residue-field invertibility of l, and a native realization R including its integral and common-field normalization [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data]. Fix closed, models, a symmetry and RingedDerivedTensorCoherence on the ordinary native module derived category [def-zl-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal-data]. Assume an actual family N E of CompletedTensorFiniteModel for every finite coefficient field E [def-sf-adic-completed-tensor-finite-models]. Then there is a CompletedTensorCommonLift: a natural invertible common-stage tensorator and unit with the associativity, left-unit, right-unit and signed-symmetry equations against the actual source constraints, and tensorFiniteAgreement at every E with the exact already supplied completion and ordinary comparison of N E. The ambient monoidal structure and finite normalized chain and derived comparisons are fixed inputs; this lemma constructs only their common-stage lift and its equations.

source.place: Lemma 7.9; BS Remark 6.8.15; original tensor descent steps 2--7 with the finite comparisons supplied as input.

proof_origin.place: Definition 3.4.10 and Remark 6.8.15; the original finite normalization and common-field descent are split into coherence and finite-agreement interfaces.

proof.text: Apply the split coherence lemma to the supplied native ringed derived tensor coherence and the family of finite normalized models. This gives the common-stage tensorator, unit, associativity, both unit equations and signed symmetry.

Apply the split finite-agreement lemma to the same family, native coherence and the coherence datum returned in the first step. This gives tensorFiniteAgreement at every finite coefficient field for the actual tensorator.
Insert the tensorator, unit, four equations and the finite-agreement family into CompletedTensorCommonLift. The constructor proof is definitional record assembly.
